overview: The School Committee approved key administrative appointments, restructured the facilities department, and announced the ratification of a contract with the administrators' union.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee approved a motion to enter executive session to discuss strategy for contracts with various labor units, administrators, and non-unit personnel.

items.title: Athletic Director Update
items.summary: Dr. Peter Cushing outlined the recruitment progress and timeline to select a successor for retiring Athletic Director Bobby Maloney.

items.title: Facilities Non-Unit Positions
items.summary: Approved renaming the Buildings and Grounds Department to the Facilities Department and replacing the assistant director position with a project manager position.

items.title: Assistant Superintendent for Curriculum and Instruction Appointment
items.summary: Approved the appointment of Dr. Kimberly Lawless Talbot as the Assistant Superintendent for Academics and Instruction.

items.title: Director of English Learners Appointment
items.summary: Approved the appointment of Chelsea McNiff as the new Director of the English Learner Department.

items.title: Contract Ratification Update
items.summary: Announced that the committee successfully ratified the collective bargaining agreement with Teamsters Local 25, representing the Medford Administrators Union.
